situation: My colleague Kim just sent the all-company email for Friday's town hall, and the Zoom link goes to last month's meeting, which is expired. She's a peer.
reply: Hey Kim, quick heads up: the Zoom link in the town hall email goes to last month's meeting and shows as expired when I click it. Easy fix with a quick resend. Happens to all of us!
note: Private DM, straight away, one plain sentence, then move on.

situation: 好朋友小雨最近口气有点重，下周三我们要一起做模拟面试，我觉得应该告诉她。想私下发微信。
reply: 有件小事有点不好意思开口，但换成是我也希望你告诉我：最近你说话时口气有点重，可能是上火或者牙齿的问题，面试前去看看牙医也许有帮助。就这个，没别的啦，周三模拟面试见！
note: 只说一次、私下说、给个可能的原因，然后马上转到别的话题。

situation: I manage a small warehouse office team. One of my reports, Derek, has had noticeable body odour for a few weeks and two people have mentioned it to me. I need to raise it with him privately.
reply: Derek, can I raise something a bit personal? It stays between us. Over the last few weeks I've noticed a body odour at times, mostly in the afternoons. I'm not assuming anything about the reason. If something's going on, a health thing or something at home, tell me and we'll work out what helps. Otherwise, can we agree you'll keep an eye on it, and that's the end of it?
note: Never mention that others complained. Say it once, in person, and don't bring it up again if it's fixed. If he mentions a health or personal issue, point him to HR or your employee assistance programme, and to a doctor for anything medical.

situation: My director Helen is presenting to the board on Zoom right now and she's sharing her whole screen. Her Slack notifications keep popping up in the corner, including one from HR about restructuring. I'm in the meeting.
reply: Helen, your Slack notifications are showing on the shared screen. Sharing just the slides window will hide them, it catches everyone on Zoom.
note: Senior person, live meeting: private chat, one line, the fix included, and never mention what the notification said.

situation: I told my gym buddy Marcus, privately, that there's been a strong smell after our sessions lately. He replied 'wow, ok, thanks for that I guess' and has been short with me since. We train together Tuesdays and Thursdays.
reply: Marcus, I didn't mean to upset you. I only said it because I'd want someone to tell me. That's all, I won't mention it again. Still on for Thursday?
note: When they get defensive, don't repeat the details or add evidence. One line, then straight back to normal. If he later raises a health worry himself, suggest a doctor and leave it there.

situation: A teammate who joined six weeks ago, Tom, keeps calling me Nicole. My name is Nicola. I let it go too long and he's now said it in meetings a dozen times. We get on well.
reply: Hey Tom, tiny thing: it's Nicola, not Nicole. Really easy mix-up, and I should have said something weeks ago!
note: Private, one line, and share the blame for the delay so he doesn't feel he's been embarrassing himself for weeks. Never mention it again.

situation: 好朋友小婷刚在我们大学同学群里发了婚礼电子请柬，上面写的是“10月18日（星期六）”，可我查了，今年10月18日是星期日。群里有三十多个人，她可能还发给了长辈。
reply: 婷婷，恭喜恭喜！小提醒一下：请柬上写的是10月18日星期六，我查了今年18号是星期日。你确认一下是日期还是星期写错了，趁大家还没安排行程赶紧改一下。
note: 马上能改的错误，要马上私聊说；一句话讲清楚，不在群里指出，说完就不再提。

situation: A woman from finance I've only met once, Joanne, is about to walk on stage to present at our all-hands, and the back of her skirt is tucked into her tights. We're both standing in the side corridor.
reply: Joanne, quick one before you go on: the back of your skirt's caught in your tights. Happens to everyone, you've got time. Good luck up there!
note: Fixable in seconds, so say it even to a near stranger: quietly, one plain sentence, then never mention it again.

situation: 朋友阿琳开了家烘焙小店，刚在朋友圈发了国庆上新的海报，上面写着“巴斯克蛋糕 6寸 ¥18.8”，店里实际卖188。下面已经有好几个人评论说要订了。
reply: 琳琳，海报好好看！小提醒：巴斯克6寸写成了¥18.8，少了个0，下面已经有人说要订了，赶紧改一下。手滑这种事谁都有过，别在意哈。
note: 马上能改的错误要马上私聊说，一句话讲清楚，不在评论区指出；已经评论的人要不要按错价卖，是她自己的决定，不用替她出主意。

situation: Le dije a mi compañera Lucía, por mensaje privado y justo antes de una reunión, que tenía pintalabios en los dientes; lo acababa de ver. Se lo quitó, pero me escribió: «Qué vergüenza, ¿desde cuándo lo tenía?». Nos llevamos bien.
reply: Tranquila, lo vi justo ahora y te lo dije al momento. Nos pasa a todos. ¿Entramos?
note: Si le da vergüenza, se quita hierro en una línea, se responde con verdad y sin detalles, y se cambia de tema.

situation: Minha colega de trabalho Carla me mandou por engano no WhatsApp um áudio que claramente era para o marido, sobre uma briga dos dois. Ouvi só os primeiros segundos, parei e apaguei. A gente se dá bem, mas não somos próximas.
reply: Carla, acho que o último áudio que você me mandou era para outra pessoa. Ouvi só o comecinho, parei e já apaguei aqui. Acontece com todo mundo!
note: Diga só que não era para você e o que fez com ele, sem comentar o conteúdo, e nunca mais toque no assunto.

situation: My mother-in-law, Linda, just posted a photo of her new credit card in the family WhatsApp group (about 30 people) to say it finally arrived. You can see the full card number and the expiry date.
reply: Linda, quick heads up: the photo of your new card in the family group shows the full number and the expiry date. Worth deleting it for everyone now: press and hold the photo and tap 'Delete for everyone'. Easy thing to miss on a phone. Happy to call and do it with you if that's easier.
note: Private message, straight away, with the fix included. If it was up for a while, suggesting she call her bank can wait for a second message once the photo is gone.

situation: My manager, Farah, just posted on LinkedIn welcoming our new hire Siobhan Walsh, but spelled her name 'Shivon' and tagged a different Siobhan Walsh. It already has 40 likes. I'm fairly junior on the team.
reply: Hi Farah, lovely post about Siobhan! Quick heads up: her name is spelled 'Shivon' in the text, and the tag goes to a different Siobhan Walsh, not ours. Easy fix with an edit.
note: Seniority doesn't change the rule: a fixable error gets a private message, one plain line and the fix, then never mention it again.

situation: 儿子14岁，上初二，最近打完球回家身上汗味很重，他自己好像没察觉。想今晚单独跟他说，又怕伤他自尊。
reply: 儿子，跟你说件小事，就咱俩之间：最近打完球回来，身上汗味挺明显的。这个年纪长身体，谁都会这样。运动完洗个澡，衣服一天一换就行，要不要买瓶止汗露，你自己挑。好了，就这些，吃饭吧。
note: 对青春期的孩子也是私下说、一句讲清楚、说明这很正常，再给一个具体办法，之后不再反复提。如果勤洗澡换衣后味道还是很重，可以带他去看看医生。

situation: My friend Sam is best man at his brother Chris's wedding on Saturday and sent me the slideshow to check. Slide 23, a group photo at the lake, clearly shows Chris's ex, Jess, standing next to him. The bride's whole family will be watching.
reply: Thanks for sending it over. One thing to catch before Saturday: slide 23, the lake photo, has Jess standing right next to Chris. A crop or a different shot from that trip would fix it. Easy one to miss in a long slideshow!
note: Fixable before the event, so say it now, privately and in one line with the fix; no commentary on what the bride would think.

situation: 先輩の田中さんと、昼にニンニクたっぷりのラーメンを食べたあと、これから客先訪問です。田中さんの口臭が気になりますが、本人は気づいていないようです。移動中に二人きりなので、今言いたいです。ミントタブレットを持っています。
reply: 田中さん、ちょっと言いにくいんですが、さっきのラーメンのニンニクが少し残っているかもしれません。ミントタブレットがあるので、よかったらどうぞ。よくあることなので、気にしないでください。
note: 目上の人でも、すぐ直せることなら二人きりのときに一言で伝え、対処法を添えて、あとは話題を変える。

situation: I just found my colleague Dan's resignation letter in the shared printer by the kitchen. Nobody else was around, so I turned it face down in the tray and didn't read past the first line. We're friendly but not close, and I want to DM him.
reply: Hey Dan, quick heads-up: something you printed is still in the kitchen printer and it looks personal. I've turned it face down in the tray and I won't mention it to anyone. Happens to everyone with that printer.
note: Don't name the letter or congratulate him in writing; he gets to announce it on his own terms.

situation: 女儿的同学朵朵周末在我们家过夜，两个孩子玩得很开心。昨晚给朵朵梳头时，我看到她头发里有几只虱子和虱卵。我和朵朵妈妈只是接孩子时认识，想私下发微信告诉她。
reply: 朵朵妈妈你好，朵朵这两天在我们家玩得很开心，谢谢你让她来！私下跟你说件小事：昨晚给她梳头时，我看到她头发里有几只小虱子和虱卵。小朋友之间传这个挺常见的，我这边也会给我女儿查一查。就这个，别有负担哈。
note: 关于孩子的尴尬事也是私下、一句说清、说明很常见，不在家长群里提，说完就不再追问。如果对方问怎么处理，建议她咨询社区医生或药店药剂师。

situation: 明天上午要和同事小王一起去客户公司提案，对方负责人姓单，读shàn。今天周会上小王一直叫他“dān总”，说了好几次，他自己没发现。我们是平级，想私下微信提醒他。
reply: 小王，明天提案前跟你说个小细节：客户那边的单总，姓读shàn，不读dān。这个字谁第一次见都会念错，明天叫对就行。明天见！
note: 明天之前就能改的事，今天私下一句话说清楚，不提周会上念了几次。

situation: 部门线上周会，二十多个人在线。同事老周讲完他的部分后忘了关麦，现在大家都能听到他在跟家里人商量孩子补课的钱，主持人还没发现。我想私聊提醒他。
reply: 周哥，你麦克风还开着，大家能听到。点一下静音就好，这种事谁都遇到过。
note: 马上能改的事，私聊一句话说清楚；不提听到了什么，会后也不再提。

situation: Voy en el metro de Madrid y la señora mayor sentada a mi lado lleva el bolso abierto; se le ve la cartera encima de todo. No la conozco y no quiero asustarla ni que parezca que la estaba mirando.
reply: Perdone, señora, lleva el bolso abierto y se le ve la cartera. Nos pasa a todos. ¡Que tenga buen día!
note: Con un desconocido basta una frase en voz baja; luego vuelve a lo tuyo, sin explicar ni vigilar.

situation: Ma collègue Sophie partage son agenda avec tout le service, une quarantaine de personnes, et ses rendez-vous du mardi soir s'affichent en clair : « Psy, Dr Morel ». On s'entend bien sans être proches, et je veux lui écrire en privé.
reply: Sophie, petite chose entre nous : dans l'agenda partagé du service, l'intitulé de tes rendez-vous du mardi soir est visible par tout le monde. Si tu les passes en « privé » dans les options du rendez-vous, les autres ne verront plus que « occupé ». Ça arrive à tout le monde avec ces agendas !
note: Ne jamais répéter ce qui est écrit dans l'intitulé : on signale le problème et la solution, puis on n'en reparle plus.

situation: I teach a Tuesday and Thursday evening strength class. One of my regulars, Jen, wore black leggings today that went see-through under the studio lights every time we did squats, and she clearly hadn't noticed. I want to say something quietly after class.
reply: Jen, can I mention something quickly, just between us? During the squats today those leggings went a bit see-through under the studio lights. It happens with lots of black leggings once they've stretched, and I'd want someone to tell me. See you next class!
note: A quiet word after class, not during it; one plain sentence, normalise it, and never bring it up again.

situation: 好朋友阿敏明天上午10点要视频面试，今晚跟我视频练习。她身后的晾衣架上挂着几件内衣，镜头里看得很清楚，她自己没发现。
reply: 敏敏，练得挺好的！有个小细节：你身后晾衣架上的内衣在镜头里能看到，明天面试前收一下或者换个角度就好。在家视频谁都遇到过，明天加油！
note: 明天就要用的镜头，今晚私下一句话说清楚，再给一个马上能做的办法，说完就回到面试本身。

situation: My desk neighbour Priya came back from two weeks' holiday on Monday, but her out-of-office is still on: I got it again when I emailed her this morning. We get on well and she clearly hasn't noticed.
reply: Priya, quick one: your out-of-office is still on, I got it again this morning. Probably worth switching off before more people see it. Everyone forgets that one after a holiday!
note: A two-minute fix gets a quick private word straight away, with no teasing about the holiday, and then it's forgotten.

situation: My friend Hannah just posted an Instagram story ranting about her boss by name, and it went to all her followers, not just her close friends list. I know a few of her coworkers follow her. It's been up about ten minutes.
reply: Hey, quick one: your latest story went out to everyone, not just close friends, and a few of your work people follow you. Might be worth deleting it now. Super easy slip, happens to everyone!
note: A five-minute fix gets a private message straight away; don't repeat what the story said and don't bring it up again.

situation: It's 11pm and I've just noticed my downstairs neighbour's car boot is wide open in our building's car park, with a laptop bag on show. I don't have his number, but I know he lives in flat 1B. I'm Ana from 2A and I'm going to knock on his door.
reply: Hi, sorry to knock so late, I'm Ana from 2A. Your car boot's open down in the car park, and there's a laptop bag on show. Thought you'd want to know before morning. Easy one to miss!
note: A quick fix for a near-stranger: tell him in person straight away rather than in the building chat, then leave it there.

situation: At my sister Mia's wedding reception, my dad Ray, who's 72, is about to stand up for his speech and his hearing aid is whistling loudly. Everyone at our table can hear it except him. I'm sitting right next to him.
reply: Dad, quick one before you go up: your hearing aid's whistling. A quick adjust should sort it. Happens all the time, and you're going to be great.
note: A parent gets the same rule as anyone: a five-second fix, one quiet line right away, then straight back to cheering him on.

situation: I'm at my friend Leo's flat for a dinner party with eight of us. I'm helping in the kitchen while he carves his first ever roast chicken, and the meat by the bone is still pink with red juices. The plates haven't gone out yet and nobody else has seen it.
reply: Leo, quick one before it goes out: it's still pink by the bone. Back in the oven for a bit should sort it, and I'll top up everyone's drinks in the meantime. Happens to everyone with their first roast!
note: Undercooked chicken can make people ill, so say it straight away, quietly in the kitchen, never at the table.

situation: 好朋友小美正在直播卖她自己做的手工香皂，现在在讲薰衣草款，但直播间挂出来的购物链接是玫瑰款，评论区已经有人在问了。我在看直播，想马上在微信上私信提醒她。
reply: 小美，直播间挂的链接是玫瑰款，不是你正在讲的薰衣草款，评论区已经有人在问了，换一下就好。直播手忙脚乱太正常了，讲得很好，继续！
note: 她马上就能改，所以要快、私下、一句话说清，别在评论区提醒。

situation: My mum, 78, has always been really particular about her clothes, but the last few times I've visited, her cardigans have had food stains down the front. Her eyesight has got worse since the spring and she's on the waiting list for a cataract operation. I'm seeing her on Sunday and want to mention it gently, once.
reply: Mum, can I mention something small, just between us? There are a few marks down the front of that cardigan, and they're easy to miss in this light. Shall I pop it in the wash while I'm here, and have a quick look through the others with you?
note: Leave her eyesight out of it unless she raises it; if you notice other everyday things slipping, suggest a GP visit together.

situation: I've been dating Jonah for six weeks and really like him. His flat has a strong cat litter smell from his cat, Miso, and I think he's gone nose-blind to it. I'm staying over on Saturday and want to mention it once, kindly, by text beforehand.
reply: Can I mention something small, the kind of thing I'd want you to tell me? The flat's had quite a strong cat litter smell the last few times I've been over. I think you just stop noticing it when you live with it; it happens to everyone with pets. That's it, and I'm really looking forward to Saturday.
note: Early dating: say it once, make it about the flat rather than him, and if it's still there on Saturday, let it go.

situation: 我是外包设计师，甲方对接人刘经理刚在他们公司的公众号上发了周六读书会的推文，我扫了一下文中的报名二维码，打开的是去年的活动页面，已经显示“报名结束”。推文发出才二十分钟，我们只是工作上的合作关系。
reply: 刘经理，读书会的推文看到了！小提醒一下：文中的报名二维码扫出来是去年的活动页面，显示“报名结束”。推文才发出二十分钟，换一下二维码就好。这种事谁都遇到过，需要的话新码我这边帮您核对。
note: 对甲方也一样：马上能改的错，私下一句话说清，附上解决办法，不在评论区提。

situation: I'm Maya Chen, a second-year student. My lecturer Dr Okafor just uploaded this week's slides to the course page, and slide 14 has a spreadsheet screenshot showing several students' names and their midterm marks. About 200 of us can see the page, and I want to email him privately.
reply: Hi Dr Okafor, a quick heads up about this week's slides on the course page: slide 14 has a spreadsheet screenshot that shows several students' names and midterm marks. It might be worth taking the file down and re-uploading it without that slide. Easy thing to miss in a long deck. Best wishes, Maya Chen
note: Name the slide and the fix, not whose marks you saw, and don't mention it on the course forum.

situation: 我在二手平台上跟一个陌生卖家买了个书架，周三收到货，挺满意。翻她其他在售商品时发现，一张台灯照片的背景里有张快递单，能看清她的全名、小区地址和手机号。想通过平台私信提醒她。
reply: 你好，书架收到了，很满意，谢谢！顺便小提醒一下：你在卖的那盏台灯，照片背景里有张快递单，能看清你的全名、地址和手机号，建议换一张图。拍照时很容易没注意到，别介意哈。
note: 对陌生人也一样：私信说、一句话讲清、附上办法，不在评论区提，也不复述具体信息。

situation: I'm hosting a birthday barbecue in our garden. My partner's colleague Rachel, who I met an hour ago, has a period stain on the back of her light jeans and doesn't seem to have noticed. There's a spare cardigan on the hook by the back door and pads in the cabinet of the upstairs bathroom, and she's at the drinks table on her own right now.
reply: Rachel, quick one, just between us: it looks like your period has come through a bit on the back of your jeans. Happens to everyone. There's a cardigan on the hook by the back door you're welcome to tie round, and pads in the cabinet in the upstairs bathroom.
note: Wait until she's alone, say it once in a low voice with the fixes ready, then go back to hosting as if nothing happened.

situation: 我是部门经理，新来的下属小郑今天第一次跟我去见客户，穿了一身新西装。在客户公司前台等着的时候，我发现他左袖口上的商标还没拆，他自己没注意到，前台桌上有剪刀。
reply: 小郑，小提醒：左袖口的商标还没拆，跟前台借一下剪刀，进会议室前剪掉就好。新西装谁都忘过，别在意。
note: 对下属也一样：趁旁边没人小声说一句，附上马上能用的办法，会后不再提。
